title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Career Mode Developer Launch Update
summary: Hear directly from the Career Mode development team following the launch of EA SPORTS FC™ 27, covering early feedback and what we’re working on.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Welcome to our first Career Mode Developer Update for FC 27! It’s been great to see so many of you jumping into both Manager and Player Career and exploring some of the new systems in FC 27, including Dynamic OVR and the updated Transfer Market.

sections.title: What We’re Hearing From You
sections.summary: Two areas we’re following particularly closely right now are Stamina and Dynamic OVR. We are seeing some players are enjoying the added squad-building and rotation challenges these systems bring, while others have told us that you’d like to see some…

sections.title: What We’re Working On
sections.summary: Alongside the areas we’re monitoring, there are a few things the team is working to address: Team Management UI: We’ve heard your feedback around the Team Management UI loud and clear. We’re planning visual updates to the Team Management Screen, more in line…

sections.title: Keep the Conversation Going
sections.summary: We’ll be hosting a Career Mode specific Q&A on October 6 in the Official EA SPORTS FC Discord, make sure to join the server and drop your questions for the team! You can also continue to share your FC 27 through the Player Feedback Portal.
